79958.subject: Robinhood Turns On 10x Crypto Perps in the US
79958.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[Robinhood](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/robinhood-begins-us-crypto-perps-rollout-with-up-to-10x-leverage)**[ started its US crypto perps rollout with up to 10x leverage on eight assets](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/robinhood-begins-us-crypto-perps-rollout-with-up-to-10x-leverage)

* **[Balancer](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/balancer-sets-shutdown-dates-after-bal-holders-approve-wind-down)**[ set Oct. 30 and Nov. 30 shutdown dates after BAL holders approved the wind-down](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/balancer-sets-shutdown-dates-after-bal-holders-approve-wind-down)

* **[Coinbase](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/coinbase-wins-cftc-approval-for-in-house-derivatives-clearing)**[ won CFTC registration for its own derivatives clearinghouse](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/coinbase-wins-cftc-approval-for-in-house-derivatives-clearing)

* **[House Oversight](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/house-oversight-expands-prediction-market-probe-to-hyperliquid)**[ widened its prediction-market insider-trading probe to Hyperliquid, Crypto.com and PredictIt's owner](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/house-oversight-expands-prediction-market-probe-to-hyperliquid)

* **[Coinbase](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/coinbase-adds-hype-and-zec-as-collateral-for-loans-of-up-to-100-000)**[ added HYPE and ZEC as collateral for Morpho-powered USDC loans of up to $100,000](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/coinbase-adds-hype-and-zec-as-collateral-for-loans-of-up-to-100-000)

Fifteen months ago Robinhood's crypto chief told The Defiant the company had built perpetual futures for European customers and was waiting on US regulators to allow the same product at home. On Sept. 29 the wait ended: eight contracts, up to 10x leverage on bitcoin and ether, 3x on the rest, no expiration date, and one basis point a trade through the end of 2026.

Robinhood [started the US rollout](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/robinhood-begins-us-crypto-perps-rollout-with-up-to-10x-leverage) through Robinhood Derivatives, a CFTC-registered futures commission merchant, with Bitstamp. The announcement leaves out the US exchange and clearing entities behind Bitstamp's role. Hours earlier, Coinbase [won CFTC registration for its own clearinghouse](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/coinbase-wins-cftc-approval-for-in-house-derivatives-clearing), and the House Oversight Committee [asked Hyperliquid for identity and suspicious-trading records](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/house-oversight-expands-prediction-market-probe-to-hyperliquid).

Three items, one direction. US retail leverage has run on workarounds for a year. Coinbase's perpetual-style futures carry five-year expirations because a true perp had nowhere to live. [Polymarket blocked US order placement](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/polymarket-opens-perps-trading-to-the-public-with-20x-leverage) when it launched
